LDL CHOLESTEROL:

Desirable:            <100 mg/dL
Above Desirable:   100-129 mg/dL
Borderline high:   130-159 mg/dL
High:              160-189 mg/dL
Very high:      > or = 190 mg/dL


Optimal results are individualized and depend on the risk factors and clinical context.  For further details, please see most recent guidelines.
